title: ScanEval precision reviews
description: The append-only history of human reviews of one precision sample's units, bound to that sample by its canonical digest. Entries form a chain whose end reviews_sha256 records, so an edited, reordered, or deleted entry is refused. It is not a signature and says nothing about who typed an entry or whether they read the claim.

sample_sha256.description: canonical_sha256 of the precision sample these reviews judge.

reviews_sha256.description: Chain value of the last entry; null exactly when there is none.

review.description: One human judgement of one sampled unit. A later entry by the same reviewer revises an earlier one; nothing is removed.

reviewer.description: The name the reviewer stated. The tool never supplies one.

at.description: When the entry was recorded. Informational: order is chain order.
